name: Макет парафіяльного костелу, м. Тернопіль
description:
**Парафіяльний костел Матері Божої Неустанної Помочі**

Втрачена римо-католицька сакральна споруда Тернополя, зведена 1908 року в центральній частині міста за проєктом архітектора Теодора-Мар’яна Тальовського. Храм належав до неоготичного стилю і був важливою висотною та містобудівною домінантою історичного середмістя.

У час Першої світової війни костел зазнав руйнувань, але його швидко відновили. У роки Другої світової костел знову зазнав руйнувань, але документальні фото свідчать, що він був у значно кращому стані, ніж Домініканський костел (відновлений у 1950-х). У 1949 p.: акт обстеження визнавав що костел в аварійному стані, однак дослідники схиляються до навмисному завищенні пошкоджень для остаточного руйнування святині. У середині 1954-му році костел було знищено радянською владою, а на його місці згодом споруджено будівлю центрального універмагу.

Сканування та обробка проведені архітекторами, учасниками ГО “Суми Майбутнього”, Ігорем Титаренком та Юрієм Леонцем.

description:
Being the fastest land mammal, the cheetah can reach speeds up to 130 km/h (80mph). To achieve this, their bodies are quite different from their close relatives of the Puma lineage. They are especially light and have streamlined bodies, additionally their claws are only semi-retractable to ensure good traction while in a high-speed chase. To reduce the risk of losing balance during runs, their lower limbs have the bones held closer together, which does reduce the cat's ability to climb trees. During their run cycle the cheetah has two periods of complete ground detachments to reduce friction.

**The asset file of this stylized cheetah contains:**

- Blender file
- Rigged body
- Demo Animation within the Blender file
- 2048x2048 Color texture in png format

name: Indian grey mongoose
description:
3D scan of the mandible of a Indian grey mongoose (*Herpestes edwardsii*).

The Indian grey mongoose is a mongoose species native to the Indian subcontinent and West Asia. It inhabits open forests, scrublands and cultivated fields, often close to human habitation. It lives in burrows, hedgerows and thickets, among groves of trees, and takes shelter under rocks or bushes and even in drains. It has a body length of 36–45 cm and a tail length of 45 cm where males are significantly larger than the females. Its prey includes rodents, snakes, birds’ eggs and hatchlings, lizards and a variety of invertebrates.

Specimen: Indian grey mongoose, *Herpestes edwardsii* (É. Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire, 1818)

description:
This is a static (spread out) 3D mesh of a male reed frog (Hyperolius riggenbachi). The 3D animation was created through combining two 3D photogrammetry scans - that of a live male in the California Academy of Sciences, and of a preserved male from the same museum. CG artists Johnson Martin and Ariadna N. created the 3D model from these scans, and from images of these live frogs. We thank Lucinda Lawson from the University of Cincinnati for funding the resaerch, and Rayna Bell from the California Academy of Sciences for providing access to specimens.

Downloads are freely available for creative and non-profit use. To inquire about licensing, please visit www.digitallife3d.org.

name: Therizinosaurus Scan
description:
**Includes**

- 4k Texture
- Optimised Scan model


Therizinosaurus was a colossal therizinosaurid that could grow up to 9–10 m (30–33 ft) long and 4–5 m (13–16 ft) tall, and weigh possibly over 5 t (5.5 short tons). Like other therizinosaurids, it would have been a slow-moving, long-necked, high browser equipped with a rhamphotheca (horny beak) and a wide torso for food processing. Its forelimbs were particularly robust and had three fingers that bore unguals which, unlike other relatives, were very stiffened, elongated, and only had significant curvatures at the tips. Therizinosaurus had the longest known manual unguals of any land animal, reaching above 50 cm (20 in) in length. Its hindlimbs ended in four functionally weight-bearing toes differing from other theropod groups in which the first toe was reduced to a dewclaw and also resembling the very distantly related sauropodomorphs.

name: Amigo Cranium
description:
This is an Orangutan cranium from a man named Amigo. He lived at the Como Zoo for many years before passing away in Dec 1992. His autopsy was completed in early 1993. His remains are kept in the Minnesota Veterinary History Museum on the Saint Paul campus. 

Amigo's cranium has the temporary catalog number CC-53

I am currently working on an independent research project to learn as much about Amigo as I can. Stay tuned for that. Fun fact. An autopsy for an animal is called a "necropsy". Technically, Amigo had a necropsy. But orangutans are so similar to us--it feels more appropriate for me to use the term autopsy; and that is a word more laypeople are familiar with.

3D scene made on Maya, textures on Substance Painter
10372 Tris 2048x2048 Map size

This is a game-ready 3D character created for a platformer video game project. For this model, I chose a mid-poly approach to achieve clean, smooth curves that highlight the strength and personality of this unicorn character.
I developed the character design myself, with valuable feedback from my teammates throughout the process. The 3D modeling took approximately three days to complete, followed by around four days dedicated to rendering.
The head was particularly challenging due to its unique and unconventional shape, but I’m very pleased with how it ultimately turned out.
I would be happy to hear your feedback and constructive criticism if you have any.

Enjoy the few that are left. By the way its capacity to bite through the shield of a turtle, has to do with upperteeth standing opposite to the lower teeth, move sideways and it acts like a saw. Dont be fooled by tv shows where you see people swimming next to tiger shark, or even showing how to dodge an attack either, they are swimming next to sharks that have just fed from whale carcasses, fully satisfied, obviously that shows radical different behaviour

name: Parasaurolophus
description:
**game: Carnivores 1 / 2**

Parasaurolophus is a large herbivorous dinosaur that appears in Carnivores, Carnivores 2, Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter, Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter HD, Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter Reborn, and Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt. Parasaurolophus is a skittish animal. apt to run at first sight of the hunter, making it a tricky animal to hunt. Regardless of its tendency to flee, Parasaurolophus is docile enough to become the first animal available to hunt in many of the games.

**reality**

Parasaurolophus (from the Greek para/παρα "next" or "near", saurus/σαυρος "lizard" and lophos/λοφος "crest" meaning "Near to the crested lizard") is a genus of hadrosaurid ornithopod dinosaur, which lived at the end of the Late Cretaceous period, between 76 and 73 million years ago,

Ancient books record that a dragon can fly fish. After hearing this, the fishermen in Chenjia Village wanted to learn this skill. When they were fishing, they encountered a storm and their boat capsized and fell into the water. Fortunately, the dragon god saved them and taught them the water cultivation method. The villagers mistakenly thought that they had drowned. When they were preparing for the funeral, the dragon brought the fish ashore and transformed into the fisherman's body. Everyone was shocked. The fisherman was exhausted after landing, but he revived after entering the water and finally realized that his life belonged to the water. Soon, the fisherman returned to the water and never appeared in the world again.

name: Random Pawpads 001
description:
After uploading my previous and first paw model here, I wanted to upload another one.

If you saw my last post here, it was a set of pawpads I designed using an AI-generated image as a reference. I didn't tag it as "created with AI" because the model was technically not created with AI as I could have and usually do use my own image references when creating my paws. Still feeling it cheating to use an AI image as a reference, I wanted to create another one. Additionally, whenever I make pawpads, I'll usually use the Blenderkit addon in Blender to add a realistic material to the pawpads. For this post, I wanted to create a fully original set of pawpads with accompanying original materials.

*I figured out how to do materials!*
Hope you enjoy!

name: Caterpillar
description: A groundbreaking discovery in the Amazon rainforest has stunned biologists: *Felis vermiformis*, a hybrid creature combining feline and caterpillar traits. This small, segmented organism features the expressive head of a domestic cat—complete with whiskers, tabby markings, and golden eyes—atop a caterpillar-like body with ten pairs of prolegs and fine green bristles. Despite its surreal appearance, *F. vermiformis* displays agile movement and surprising camouflage abilities. Researchers believe its evolution may be linked to mimicry and predator avoidance. The creature’s emergence challenges conventional taxonomy and opens new questions about genetic convergence in isolated ecosystems.

name: Écureuil v4
description:
Le terme écureuil est un nom vernaculaire ambigu qui désigne en français de nombreuses espèces de rongeurs grimpeurs de taille moyenne, parfois même « volants ». Leur queue, plus ou moins touffue selon les espèces, forme un panache ou un plumeau caractéristique. Ils appartiennent presque tous à la famille des Sciuridés, qui comprend aussi les chiens de prairies et les marmottes, mais quelques écureuils volants font partie de la famille des Anomaluridés.

La queue en panache de l’écureuil et son acharnement à faire des provisions pour l’hiver ont contribué à sa popularité et en ont fait un animal emblématique souvent présent dans la symbolique et la culture.

Sites 1 Youtube Cri de l’écureuil : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9yJ17BXxfUY

Sites 2 Youtube Cri de l’écureuil : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5XneryrioY

name: Heloderma suspectum (MSB:Herp:58463)
description:
A charismatic North American reptile, the Gila monster is the only venomous lizard native to the United Sates.  Its orange and black beaded appearance gave inspiration for the Genus name Heloderma - "studded skin".  Beneath each bump is an osteoderm - small bone within the skin - forming an armor that covers most of the body.   Once a common lizard in the Southwestern United States and Northern Mexico, it is now threatened due to habbitat loss.

References:

* [Animal Diversity Web](https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Heloderma_suspectum/)
* [MSB:Herp:58463](https://arctos.database.museum/guid/MSB:Herp:58463) (Division of Amphibians and Reptiles, Museum of Southwestern Biology, University of New Mexico)

name: modelo 3 y 4 ventrículo de cerebro bobino
description:
Modelo anatómico del tercer y cuarto ventrículo cerebral en encéfalo bovino. 

En el modelo de ventrículos cerebrales de un bovino se observa el tercer ventrículo como una cavidad delgada ubicada entre los tálamos, que se comunica con los ventrículos laterales por los agujeros de Monro y con el cuarto ventrículo a través del acueducto de Silvio.
El cuarto ventrículo tiene forma de rombo y se encuentra entre el cerebelo y el tronco encefálico. De él parte el canal central hacia la médula espinal y se comunica con el espacio subaracnoideo por los orificios de Magendie y Luschka.
gracias por la oportunidad en las jornadas y esperamos que fuera de su agrado

A stylized baby dinosaur created as a personal real-time character project. The goal was to design a charming, expressive creature with clean topology while keeping the asset optimized for games and interactive applications.

The complete modeling, sculpting, retopology, UV unwrapping, rigging, and rendering were created in Blender, while all textures were authored in Adobe Substance 3D Painter using a PBR workflow.

The project focuses on appealing proportions, a clear silhouette, expressive facial features, and a polished stylized presentation.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex 4.3
description:
# Available on Fab:
# https://fab.com/s/c95c2b9f31c0

This Trex was sculpted in zbrush, textured in Substance Painter and Photoshop, rigged and animated in blender.

Textures png 4096x4096.

Tyrannosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning king in Latin), often called T. rex or colloquially T-Rex, is one of the best represented theropods. Tyrannosaurus lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of rock formations dating to the Maastrichtian age of the Upper Cretaceous period, 68 to 66 million years ago. It was the last known member of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.

name: Kościół Farny w Żarach
description:
Kościół farny w Żarach.

Pierwszą romańską światynię wzniesiono w XIII w., a obecna gotycka bryła powstawała etapami od XIV do XVI w. Kościół wielokrotnie przebudowywano m. in. po pożarze w 1684 r. i zniszczeniach roku 1944 r. Po wojnie kościół otrzymał wezwanie Najświętszego Serca Pana Jezusa.

The parish chyrch in Żary [Poland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fyvLDExAbxEH5Ccy8).

The first Romanesque church was erected in the 13th century, while the present Gothic structure developed in stages from the 14th to the 16th century. The church was rebuilt several times, including after the fire of 1684 and the destruction of 1944. After the war, it was dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

7441 photos, DJI Mavic 3 Classic

[Zdjęcia/ Photos](https://polska-org.pl/512498,Zary,Kosciol_Najswietszego_Serca_Pana_Jezusa.html)

name: High-Poly Gondola Shelf Unit — Retail Display
description:
A detailed, realistic gondola shelving unit modeled after standard convenience store and supermarket center-aisle fixtures, with fully modeled perforated holes throughout the back wall and shelf decks — real geometry, not faked with textures.

Features:

Fully modeled perforated back wall and shelf holes (real geometry)
Detailed peg-hook attachment points along the back wall
Standard real-world sizing, so multiple units can be placed side by side to form longer gondola runs/aisles
Clean, evenly spaced shelf layout typical of real-world gondola systems
Accurate proportions based on real retail shelving standards
Simple 2-piece structure split by material, for easy setup and material editing

Specs:

~233k triangles
Modeled in Blender
2 objects (split by material)

Ideal for retail environment scenes, store interior visualizations, product placement renders, or archviz projects needing an authentic convenience store aisle look.

name: Carlos Quinto
description:
Rielaborazione 3D didattica del “Carlos Quinto a cavallo” di Tiziano
Questa ricostruzione tridimensionale si ispira al celebre ritratto di Carlo V a cavallo, dipinto da Tiziano nel 1548. L’imperatore è raffigurato in armatura, fiero dopo la vittoria di Mühlberg: un’immagine di potere, disciplina e… forse anche un po’ di autopromozione regale.

E qui entra in gioco Alghero, che Carlo V visitò di persona nel 1541. Secondo la tradizione, rivolgendosi alla popolazione, disse: «Estade todos caballeros» (“Siate tutti cavalieri”). Una frase diventata leggenda, anche se gli storici discutono su quando, come e perché sia stata detta… e su quanto fosse sincera, considerando i secoli di dominazione che seguirono.
Vero o no, l’espressione è rimasta scolpita nella memoria collettiva e, ancora oggi, fa sorridere e riflettere sugli intrecci fra storia, orgoglio e identità locale.

A cura di Alessio Langella, Istituto Tecnico Industriale di Alghero

name: Matt Brien (1814-41) Headstone
description: One of 157 headstones in Burgesbeg graveyard (TN025-038003-), Co. Tipperary recorded in 1988 by the Ormond Historical Society. 19th-century headstone marking the grave of Matt Brien who died in 1841 aged 27.  Erected by his father James Brien. Above the inscription there is a large  sunburst motif with triangle in the centre with sunrays radiating outwards. Above the sunburst there is a Greek-Cross with expanded terminals, decorated with rosettes, flanked by a soul-effigy, beneath which there is a Noah's Dove, olive tree & encircled crowing-rooster, beneath these there are two encircled six-pointed rosettes/stars or hexafoil motifs / Daisy-Wheel symbol which may have served as an apotropaic mark. All the symbols are framed within a sunburst border. In Christian symbolism, a triangle within a sunburst (or rays of light) commonly represents the Holy Trinity, with the triangle symbolizing God the Father,  the Son (Jesus Christ), and the Holy Spirit. The sunburst, signifies God's radiance or divine presence.

name: WingBox + logo Polytron
description:
Truk wingbox adalah truk dengan sisi yang bisa dibuka seperti sayap, memudahkan bongkar muat barang dari tiga sisi. Kelebihannya adalah efisiensi waktu, akses mudah ke muatan, perlindungan barang dari cuaca dan debu, kapasitas muatan besar, dan fleksibilitas penggunaan untuk berbagai jenis barang. 
Truk wingbox adalah satu dari beberapa jenis truk yang biasa digunakan untuk mendistribusikan atau mengirimkan barang. Dapat dikatakan armada ini mirip dengan tronton box. Hanya saja, terdapat perbedaan dalam hal kapasitas max load, serta beberapa benefit lain.
Proses bongkar muat jadi lebih mudah Dengan sisi yang bisa dibuka ke atas, barang bisa dimasukkan dan dikeluarkan dengan gampang dari berbagai arah. Hal ini tentu bikin kerja jadi lebih efisien.
Ideal untuk barang yang besar dan panjang: Kalau bisnis Anda sering mengirim barang yang panjang seperti pipa atau kayu, wing box truk bisa jadi pilihan yang pas.
Meminimalkan kemungkinan kerusakan barang: Dengan ruang yang lebih teratur.

name: Maquette of William Wallace, Edinburgh Castle
description:
This is a maquette of William Wallace by Alexander Carrick, a Scottish sculptor active in the early 20th century.

A maquette is a preliminary model made before a larger piece of sculpture in order to plan out how it may look and how it might be be made. 

This maquette is linked with the [8-foot bronze sculpture of William Wallace](https://canmore.org.uk/collection/2121816) that can be seen in the niches set in Edinburgh Castle's walls on the right side of the gateway, completed in 1929.

For more information about Edinburgh Castle, go to [our website](https://www.edinburghcastle.scot/).

Rae Project | E5657

name: 1995 McLaren F1 GTR
description:
The McLaren F1 GTR is the racing variant of the McLaren F1 sports car first produced in 1995 for grand touring style racing, such as the BPR Global GT Series, FIA GT Championship, JGTC, and British GT Championship. It was powered by the naturally aspirated BMW S70/2 V12 engine. It is most famous for its overall victory at the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans where it won against faster purpose-built prototypes in very wet conditions. The F1 GTR raced internationally until 2005 when the final race chassis was retired.

Gordon Murray, creator of the McLaren F1, originally saw his creation as the ultimate road car, with no intention to take the car racing. Although the car used many racing technologies and designs, it was felt that the car should be a road car first, without any intent built into the creation of the car to modify it into a racing car.

name: Bulwark-X
description:
Bulwark-X is a game-ready hard-surface asset developed to showcase two different production workflows, each designed for real-time rendering and game development.
The first version follows a traditional AAA pipeline. A high-poly model was created to capture the mechanical details and surface definition, which were then transferred to an optimized low-poly mesh through baking. The final asset was completed using a PBR texturing workflow, resulting in a detailed, efficient model ready for use in modern game engines.

The second version explores a more lightweight and stylized approach. Instead of using a conventional PBR texture set, the low-poly model was UV-mapped to a single gradient color texture, composed of vertical color bands and gradients. This technique allows the entire asset to be rendered using a single texture while maintaining visual depth and a clean, readable aesthetic. It's a highly efficient workflow that minimizes texture memory while remaining ideal for real-time applications.

name: Steve- Triumph TF 250-X-33
description: Triumph holds Steve McQueen so dear that his image has practically become the brand's symbol. Hinckley never misses a chance to remind everyone that the famous actor loved Triumphs, loved motorcycles, loved competition, and lived the biking life with a passion that went far beyond the ordinary. Yet, until now, only one model had the honor of bearing his name: the 2012 special-edition 865 Bonneville. This time, the 1200 Scrambler takes up the mantle. But make no mistake—this isn't just a case of throwing in a sticker, a cap, and a T-shirt. No, this involves a special paint job and select accessories fitted to the top-spec XE model—a bike already boasting a list of features as long as the phone book for the next village over. The McQueen family was consulted during the model's development, resulting in a distinctly more premium feel. It looks like a young English aristocrat with a taste for mischief—especially when tearing up rough pastures. "Who gives a damn about hunting deer? I’d rather go hunting for mud!"

name: KC1 TriStar (Lockheed L-1011)
description:
The Lockheed TriStar is a retired air-to-air tanker and transport aircraft formerly in service with the Royal Air Force (RAF). All are converted civilian Lockheed L-1011-500 TriStar airliners—previously operated by British Airways and Pan American World Airways—and entered service with the RAF in 1984.

The converted aircraft were purchased following the Falklands War, after a requirement for additional air-to-air refuelling (AAR) operations had been identified. Of the nine in service, two were tankers (K1) with passenger space and also limited space for cargo loaded aft of the main deck; three were solely transport aircraft (C2); and the remaining four (KC1) could be used for either of the two roles. The TriStars formed the air-to-air refuelling fleet of the RAF until replaced by the Airbus A330 MRTT under the Future Strategic Tanker Aircraft (FSTA) programme. It was retired in 2014.

name: Glacial dream
description:
It's a 100% crystalized dream.

One day I dreamed about a car, balancing form and function. The car that skips unnecessary rules, but will be true to life. So, rear mirrors are replaced with cameras, and wipers are hidden by default. I bet you found a few more unusual things.

I started this project a while ago, planning to push my boundaries further. No AI, no reference to other cars. Everything is based on my own. In this mad world is important to be able to use your own imagination. So I started with paper drawings. During the process, I switched my pipelines from 3ds Max to Blender. The model is game-ready, but for the wheels, I spent a bit more polygons to make them smooth.

Enjoy

name: Alfa Romeo 164
description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DudzN1tK0U0

This business-class sedan produced by Alfa Romeo from 1987 to 1998. It was the flagship model of the brand. A total of 273857 cars were produced.

In October 1978, Alfa Romeo, FIAT, Lancia and SAAB came to an agreement to develop separate business class models on the Type Four platform, thus, such cars as the Alfa Romeo 164, Saab 9000, Fiat Croma, Lancia Thema appeared in the development process. . The FIAT and Lancia models were similar to the Saab in many ways, while the Alfa Romeo 164 shared only the chassis with them.

The 164 was designed by Enrico Fumia of Pininfarina. In 1993, the design of the model was slightly updated. Over the years of production, cars have been equipped with a wide range (16 versions) of V-shaped and in-line engines ranging 2-3 liters. Some versions were equipped with turbocharging and/or valvetrain. 2 versions of the car out of 16 produced had a diesel engine.

![](https://i.imgur.com/u6aVpLV.jpg)

description:
Cute Fox Adventurer generated with SupaVoxel ([supavoxel.com](https://supavoxel.com/?utm_source=sketchfab&utm_medium=ugc&utm_campaign=sanasokolov&utm_content=pool890)) from a single picture. Free tier, no sign-up wall: upload one image, get a textured GLB/STL back in a couple of minutes.

Delete the 'supavoxel-badge' node for the clean mesh. Download is free (CC-BY); GLB/OBJ/STL conversions are in the Sketchfab download menu.

name: Alexander_von_Reit
description:
Alexander von Reit – Der Wandel vom Schwert zur Maschine
Im 19. Jahrhundert, als Łódź von einer unscheinbaren Siedlung zur pulsierenden Industriestadt erwachte, trat Alexander von Reit aus dem Schatten seiner Ahnen hervor. Die alte Ordnung des Rittertums verlor an Bedeutung, doch Alexander erkannte früh: Die Macht lag nicht mehr im Schwert, sondern in der Maschine.

Mit klarem Blick und unerschütterlichem Willen errichtete er Fabriken, verband Wissen mit Disziplin und schuf Strukturen, die Generationen überdauern sollten. In seiner Hand hielt er das Zahnrad – Symbol der neuen Zeit – und in der anderen die Pläne einer Zukunft, die er selbst formte.

Doch tief in ihm lebte der alte Kodex weiter: Ehre, Verantwortung und der Schutz der Schwächeren. So wurde Alexander von Reit zur Brücke zwischen zwei Welten – Ritter und Industrieller zugleich.

name: 聖大雅各像 St James the Greater Statue in Laterano
description:
卡米洛·魯斯科尼創作的《聖大雅各》雕像（約1703–1711年）位於羅馬拉特朗聖若望大殿。這尊高約4.5米的大理石雕像是教宗克勉十一世委託製作的十二宗徒巨型雕像系列之一，旨在填充弗朗切斯科·博羅米尼設計的壁龕。魯斯科尼是該項目的核心雕塑家。聖雅各伯（大）是西庇太的兒子，耶穌的十二宗徒之一，傳統上被描繪為朝聖者，手持朝聖杖，帽子上飾有扇貝殼（通往聖地亞哥德孔波斯特拉朝聖之路的象徵）。雕像莊嚴肅穆，融合了巴洛克的動感與古典的平衡。

The Statue of St James the Greaterby Camillo Rusconi (c. 1703–1711) is housed in the Archbasilica of St. John Lateran in Rome. This approximately 4.5-meter marble statue was part of Pope Clement XI's commission for twelve colossal apostle figures to fill the niches designed by Francesco Borromini. Rusconi was a central sculptor in this project. St James the Greater, son of Zebedee and one of the Twelve Apostles, is traditionally depicted as a pilgrim, holding a staff and with a scallop shell on his hat (symbol of the pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela). The work presents a solemn figure, blending Baroque dynamism with classical equilibrium.
